title: Intuitive Machines Q2 2026 earnings release, SEC-filed Exhibit 99.1
excerpt: The release reports Q2 revenue of USD 206 million, cash of USD 367 million, backlog of USD 1.8 billion, and retains full-year revenue guidance of USD 900 million to USD 1 billion with positive adjusted EBITDA.
summary: The SEC-filed earnings exhibit provides management's Q2 highlights, award commentary, backlog framing, and unchanged full-year outlook; the Form 10-Q remains authoritative for detailed financials and risks.
